reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:138-151, checkIfIsAvailable uses workingHours.find() to return false whenever any workingHour matching slotStartTime.day() does not contain the slot, requiring a slot to fall within every range for that weekday rather than at least one. Because packages/lib/availability.ts:74-121 emits multiple disjoint WorkingHours entries for the same weekday when a user has split hours or hours that cross UTC midnight, valid slots on those days are rejected.
